actions.name: assistant.openChat
actions.title: Open Chat

actions.name: assistant.openPet
actions.title: Open Pet
actions.description: Opens the pet or mobile assistant without starting microphone capture.

actions.name: assistant.muteMicrophone
actions.title: Mute Microphone

actions.name: session.start

actions.name: session.submitCorrection

actions.name: session.raisePrompt
actions.title: Raise Attribution Question
actions.description: Raises a silent in-app attribution question for every participant in a live session.

actions.name: attestation.request
actions.title: Request Attestation
actions.description: Raises an attestation request for the user to approve on their device. Only creates the request: attestation always completes with a biometric ceremony in the app, and no agent can sign on the user's behalf.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.title: Purpose-specific payload recorded with the request

parameters.name: summary
parameters.title: One line shown on the approval screen

actions.name: people.resolve
actions.title: Resolve a Person
actions.description: Finds the people matching a name, email or handle, and returns the candidates with how each was identified. A display name is not an identity: the same person appears under a session name, an invitation email and a join code, and two people can share a first name. Call this before any search that names a person, and if more than one candidate comes back, ask the user which one rather than choosing.

parameters.name: query
parameters.title: Name, email or handle to resolve

parameters.name: project
parameters.title: Limit to people seen in this project

actions.name: evidence.search
actions.title: Search Attributions
actions.description: Searches the recorded attribution history: who played what, on which track, when. Takes a resolved person ID from ark.people.resolve, never a bare name. Results state how each attribution was established and where it stands, and every row cites the evidence it came from. Declared, DAW-metadata and model-inferred attributions are different classes of claim and are reported separately rather than merged.

parameters.name: from
parameters.title: Earliest date to include, ISO-8601. Filters when the work happened, not when it was recorded.

parameters.name: status
parameters.title: Limit to claimed, confirmed, disputed or withheld

parameters.name: source
parameters.title: Limit to declared, dawMetadata or inferred
